About me

I'm Anthony Ohemeng, an AI Video Creator, Instructional Designer and EdTech Content Developer based in Ghana.

I specialise in transforming curriculum requirements and learning indicators into engaging digital learning experiences using AI-powered creative tools.

My work combines educational content development, instructional design, AI-generated visuals, video production and quality assurance.

I'm particularly interested in using AI to make educational and digital content more engaging, accessible and scalable.

Production process

Ten steps from indicator to final cut

Every video starts with what learners need to know, and every AI clip earns its place in the edit.

00:0000:1000:2000:3000:4000:5001:0001:1001:2001:30

V1 · PRODUCTION

  1. 01Learning IndicatorWhat must learners know or do?
  2. 02Research & PlanningFacts, context, audience
  3. 03ScriptNarration and scene beats
  4. 04StoryboardShot-by-shot visual plan
  5. 05AI PromptsPrecise, consistent prompts
  6. 06AI VisualsImages, characters, scenes
  7. 07Video GenerationMotion from stills
  8. 08EditingPacing, voice, captions, music
  9. 09Quality AssuranceAccuracy and curriculum fit
  10. 10Final VideoReady for the classroom

Steps 01–04 are instructional design. Steps 05–08 are AI production. Step 09 checks both, so the finished video is accurate as well as engaging.

Experience

Where I've been creating

TECHAiDE
EDUCATION CONTENT / AI VIDEO PRODUCTION

At TECHAiDE I develop educational content and AI-produced video for ASANKA, a digital learning platform that brings curriculum resources to schools across Ghana.

  • Curriculum-aligned videos. Producing science and early-years videos mapped to Ghana's Common Core Programme learning indicators.
  • Scripts and storyboards. Writing and planning lessons so each video teaches one clear idea.
  • AI production. Generating visuals and motion with AI tools, then editing them into finished lessons.
  • Quality assurance. Reviewing content for accuracy, age-appropriateness and curriculum fit.
